segments.normalizedSource: ```swift var estimates: [NSNumber: StrokeSample] func addSamples(for touches: [UITouch]) { if let stroke = strokeCollection?.activeStroke { for touch in touches { if touch == touches.last { let sample = StrokeSample(point: touch.location(in: self), forceValue: touch.force) stroke.add(sample: sample) registerForEstimates(touch: touch, sample: sample) } else { let sample = StrokeSample(point: touch.location(in: self), forceValue: touch.force, coalesced: true) stroke.add(sample: sample) registerForEstimates(touch: touch, sample: sample) } } self.setNeedsDisplay() } } func registerForEstimates(touch : UITouch, sample : StrokeSample) { if touch.estimatedPropertiesExpectingUpdates.contains(.force) { estimates[touch.estimationUpdateIndex!] = sample } } ```
